statement: Discovery checks its ISA/FP environment and preset, hydro and structure integer domains before world construction while preserving existing world generation; exploratory results remain uncertified. Compile-time injected CPU profiles cover missing FMA, disabled OS AVX state and every required feature for GNU/Clang and MSVC, including optional Jolt AVX-512. The CLI smoke exercises the supported host profile. Child-process controls set each unsupported rounding mode and the independent MXCSR rounding, FTZ and DAZ states, then require refusal with empty stdout before argument parsing; a supported-state control emits a complete document.
